title: Hides Warning Botton
description: A simple resource pack to hide the Warning Button. it does not disable it; just hide it.
body:
A simple resource pack to hide the Warning Button. It does not disable it; it just hides it, which mean is fully functional invisible. I like it very much because I think it's pretty ugly.
PD: the button exists so you don't get a soft-locker in that dialogue. It's important.


Works for 1.21.6+ version Until Mojang says: "Change: <warning_button.png> to <warning-button.png>"
Or similar thing


Have fun


_[Catala]_ 

Un Simple resource pack per oculta el botó d'emergència; vist en la pàgina de diàleg, serveix perquè no et quedis bloquejat. Aquest resource pack només l'oculta, però la seva funció segueix totalment bé.

Funciona per les versions 1.21.6+, fins que Mojang digui: "Canviat: "warning_button.png" a "warning-button.png"
Divertir-vos


_This is a port from [Planetminecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/hides-warning-botton/)_
